```sql
SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(p1.geometry, p2.geometry)) AS bearing_degrees
FROM (
    SELECT geometry FROM pois 
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%University of Tennessee Health Science Center%' 
    AND addr_city ILIKE '%Memphis%' 
    AND addr_state ILIKE '%TN%' 
    LIMIT 1
) AS p1,
(
    SELECT geometry FROM pois 
    WHERE tourism = 'viewpoint' 
    AND ST_DWithin(
        geometry::geography, 
        (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%University of Tennessee Health Science Center%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 
        100000
    ) 
    LIMIT 1
) AS p2;
```

```sql

WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%UIS Greenhouse%' AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%Springfield%' AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%IL%'
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(
    ST_Centroid((SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Plaza Sports Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Edinburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1)),
    ST_Centroid(poi.geometry)
)) AS direction_degrees,
    poi.poi_name
FROM pois AS poi

    ST_Centroid((SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Plaza Sports Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Edinburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1))::geography,
```

```sql
SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(p1.geometry, p2.geometry)) AS bearing_degrees
FROM (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM pois
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mentor Civic Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Mentor%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%'
    LIMIT 1
) AS p1,
(
    SELECT ST_Centroid(p.geometry)
    FROM parks p
    WHERE park_name ILIKE '%garden%'
    AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Mentor%' LIMIT 1))
    LIMIT 1
) AS p2
WHERE ST_DWithin(p1.geometry::geography, p2.geometry::geography, 150000);
```

```sql
SELECT r.road_name, r.highway
FROM roads r
WHERE ST_DWithin(
    r.geometry::geography,
    (SELECT p.geometry FROM pois p WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%Manatee Viewing Center%' AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%Apollo Beach%' AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%FL%' LIMIT 1)::geography,
    70000
)
AND ST_Intersects(
    r.geometry::geography,
    (SELECT g.geometry FROM pois g WHERE g.poi_name ILIKE '%gallery%' LIMIT 1)::geography
)
ORDER BY r.geometry <-> (SELECT p.geometry FROM pois p WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%Manatee Viewing Center%' AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%Apollo Beach%' AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%FL%' LIMIT 1) ASC
LIMIT 10;
```

```sql
    (SELECT p.geometry FROM pois p WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel%' AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%Bedford%' LIMIT 1)::geography,

)
```
